import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    home = lines[0].split("=")[1].strip()
    for raw in lines[1:]:
        if not raw.strip():
            continue
        parts = raw.split(";")
        title = parts[0].strip() if len(parts) > 0 else ""
        first = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        last = parts[2].strip() if len(parts) > 2 else ""
        street = parts[3].strip() if len(parts) > 3 else ""
        postcode = parts[4].strip() if len(parts) > 4 else ""
        city = parts[5].strip() if len(parts) > 5 else ""
        country = parts[6].strip() if len(parts) > 6 else ""

        name_line = " ".join(filter(None, [title, first, last])).strip()
        if not name_line:
            name_line = "To the occupant"

        if street:
            print(name_line)
            print(street)
        else:
            continue

        address_line = " ".join(filter(None, [postcode, city])).strip()
        if address_line:
            print(address_line)
        else:
            continue

        if country and country != home.upper():
            print(country.upper())
        else:
            continue

        print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
